findings.result: Keep existing 22-line core-policy wrapper. No custom seed arithmetic, RNG, persistent state, widget layout change or duplicate cache implementation is needed.

Fixed-mode forwarding and selected-policy checks missed three deliberately broken variants. Strengthened both hooks, all control policies, legacy false, call count, receiver/arguments/return and exception restoration.
Clarified that spies verify the delegation boundary; actual seed updates and queue bookkeeping are checked by Chrome, not a copied core algorithm.
Added after-queue decrement/randomize for both node types; all three policies now exercise both timings. 24 fixed cases plus 18 other cache/native cases and 8 original PNG restorations passed.
Documented Node test command and boundary; repaired stale pytest selection; removed abandoned-patch history from the PR draft.

retained_limits: Subgraph-promoted seed remains outside the node-local guard.
Inspire GlobalSeed rewrites remain external; prior review is source-only.
This review did not rerun full catalog or rendering; prior original-image and three-queue independent-sampler evidence has identical production code.
